Each Canadian province sends their select number of players since Canada Summer Games is the highest level of national competition for Canadian junior athletes.

posts.text: It’s been 10 days since Toronto Tech Week ended. And it still feels so surreal. 600+ events, thousands of attendees, and countless memories.
